name: Mitten Extracts Disposable | Sugar Plumz
description: Rich, juicy, and candy-sweet, Sugar Plumz delivers a flavor that’s as playful as it is indulgent. Each pull bursts with dark fruit notes and a silky finish that keeps you coming back. Smooth, cozy, and slightly decadent — this one’s built for flavor lovers who want something a little extra.
